name: lower_karazhan_halls
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 532, prepped in task B1 (TortoiseBots-audit RAID-PREP-lkh) from the world DB, the core's lower_karazhan_halls scripts and the server's map 532 navmesh. Not mapped, not live-checked: the GM-invisible mapping walk (B2) and the first live run are still to do; dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.

Packs: the export's 137 pull groups (392 units) become 93 pull groups: the runts (4075 Rat 38 spawns, 14881 Spider 61 spawns: level 1, rank 0, faction 28 'Prey' and 148 'Ambient') are in no pull; the rest are chained where they stand within 15 yd on one floor (|dz| <= 4) and where the walk from one to the next is no longer than 2.2 times their distance plus 8 yd (the map's inner walls chain units that stand close in a line but in different rooms: four groups split for it); every hostile spawn within a pack's radius + 3 is then pulled into it, up to 8 units. Each group's radius is its own spread from the centre plus 0.5, capped by the nearest spawn of every entry and at most 35.

14261 Blue Drakonid (-11333.2 -1782.75 179.73, faction 80 'Brood of Deathwing') is in no pull: the map 532 mesh has no normal path between it and any of the other 102 plan points, so it is not on the raid's route.

Boss order: Lord Blackwald II (61222) has no world spawn; the instance script summons him at -11088.2 -1995.74 76.1774 when the Dark Rider Champion (61204) is DONE (instance_lower_karazhan_halls.cpp Update). Moroes (61225) is last: his gossip offers the challenge option only when Araxxna, Blackwald II, Howlfang and Grizikil are all DONE (boss_moroes.cpp OnGossipHello), and the plan talks to him (menu index 0) before its boss step.
Grizikil's Aggro puts every Grellkin (61195, 61196, 61197) within 190 yd into combat with the zone (boss_grizikil.cpp Aggro), so his leg comes after all nine Grellkin packs within that radius.

Doors: the map's 26 game objects are door models at state 1 (open: two Karazahn_diningDoors, the diningruinDoor, the PVP_Lordaeron_Door and a copy at z 274.9), three Backup Servant Storage chests 2020050, a Lost and Found Box 2020040, four Medivh's Merlot chests, an Anvil and two quest objects (Strange Marble Bust 2020051, The Orb of Pyforos 2020052). No door, lever or key gates the route, so the plan has no object step.

Patrols: 14 map 532 spawns have a waypoint path (creature_movement, movement type 2); 10 pull groups carry a patrol block (the path and a period estimated from it at 2.5 yd/s, period_estimate, which plan-check warns about): the mapping walk measures the real rounds.

Approach points: the run leader walks toward a pack it cannot see in hops of its own; 43 approach stands (40 packs and 3 bosses) sit on their packs' own floors (15-28 yd from the pack, a complete server path to it), and every leg starts at a stand its first pack can be pulled from. plan-check: ok, 353 points, 0 failures, the 10 estimated-patrol warnings only.

Moroes' fight has a tank swap the plan cannot express: Glittering Dust (57095) drops the tank's threat by 100 % and moves him to the second on the threat list (boss_moroes.cpp TryCastGlitteringDust); the bots' own raid strategy (LowerKarazhanDungeonStrategies.cpp, EnableCustomRaidTactics) is the only handling.
Chests, the anvil and the two quest objects are left alone: a raid clear needs none of them.

legs.name: entrance_hall_ring
notes: The entrance hall from the trigger landing: 21 packs, the Patches and Props (Phantom Guardsman 61200, Haunted Blacksmith 61202, Phantom Cook 61210, Shadowbane Glimmer/Servants) and the Dark Rider Champion (61204, a 12-point patrol, 218 yd, about 87 s at 2.5 yd/s) whose death makes the instance summon Lord Blackwald II.

legs.name: entrance_hall_west
notes: The west hall dining room, one pack: a lone Shattercage Magiskull 61199 at -11121.4 -1894.8; a leg of its own because the hall wall between it and the room before it turns the tank look into a 129 yd way round.

legs.name: entrance_hall_dining
notes: The west hall, two packs of Phantom Guardsman 61200 and Haunted Blacksmith 61202.

legs.name: entrance_hall_east
notes: The west hall east side, two packs of Haunted Stable Tender 61201.

legs.name: brood_queen_araxxna
notes: The spider wing below the hall (z 45.9-51.2): Skitterweb Crawler 61206, Darkfang 61207, Venomfang 61208 (patrol), Leaper 61209, Phantom Servant 61205 and Master Blacksmith Rolfen 61319 by his anvil; Brood Queen Araxxna (61221) last. She spawns two Skitterweb Eggs (30008) every 28-34 s; an egg kills itself after 20 s and hatches a random spider (61206/61207/61209) in combat (skitterweb_eggAI), so killing eggs is wasted damage.

legs.name: spider_wing
notes: The lower spider wing south of Araxxna: the two long Venomfang patrols (61208, 11 and 12 points, 278 and 367 yd) and the crawler packs.

legs.name: north_bridge
notes: A single Phantom Guardsman pair on the ledge at z 66.8, before the bridge; its own leg because the bridge is reached by a stair the look cannot see up.

legs.name: north_bridge_east
notes: The north bridge at z 80: five packs of Shadowbane Darkcaster/Ambusher/Ragefang (61192/61193/61194) and Haunted Servants, with the 61191 Alpha patrol (12 points, 444 yd).

legs.name: grizikil
notes: The north-east upper hall and the Grellkin wing (z 86-97): Shadowbane packs, then every Grellkin pack within Grizikil's 190 yd aggro (61195 Shadow Weaver, 61196 Primalist, 61197 Channeler), then Grizikil (61224) last: his Aggro puts every Grellkin within 190 yd into combat with the zone (boss_grizikil.cpp), so they must be dead first.

legs.name: clawlord_howlfang
notes: The bridge to Clawlord Howlfang (61223): three Shadowbane packs at z 92.8-93.8, then the boss. Terrifying Presence 57083 every second, Slavering Bite 57076 on a random melee target, Shadowbane Curse 57084 every 48 s, a 30 % frenzy 57082.

legs.name: karazhan_terrace
notes: The terrace above the north hall (z 121.7-124.5): four single packs (Phantom Cook 61210, Phantom Servant 61205, Phantom Guardsman 61200); the 61200 patrol of 22 points runs the whole terrace.

legs.name: moroes_wing
notes: The north-east wing (z 90.5-110.5): Shattercage packs, the 61199 Magiskull patrol (10 points, 223 yd) and the Hall of Honour. Moroes waits beyond.

legs.name: moroes

gossip.fail_text: Moroes' menu has no challenge option: one of the four bosses before him is not dead (his gossip checks Araxxna, Clawlord Howlfang, Grizikil and Lord Blackwald II DONE), or the bot is not in the instance.

notes: The Moroes room (z 78.4-90.5): four packs, then the gossip step (menu index 0, "I am here to challenge you.") that turns Moroes hostile, then the boss. His menu offers it only when Araxxna, Blackwald II, Howlfang and Grizikil are all DONE.
